verdict.rationale: Notte documents a REST API with Bearer authentication and has a changelog page, but nothing in the evidence describes API versioning (e.g. version paths or headers) or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. API stability policy is a fair question for an API-first browser infrastructure product, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
